title.rendered: Bengaluru Boy by Danish Sait | Stand Up Comedy

content.rendered:
The Bengaluru Boy is coming to Courtyard Koota!

Through the month of October, Danish Sait brings his first-ever stand-up comedy special Bengaluru Boy to the city that made him who he is. So you don`t have to worry about braving the traffic, the Bengaluru boy will do it for you.

Malhar Laugh Club is thrilled to bring this show to our backyard. Watch the show live before it travels the world and for the first time ever, meet everyone`s favourite Mr.Nags. Limited seats.

Age: 16+

This show is sold out!
